title: Estagiário de Soluções Digitais
description:
Somos a Strattner.
Desenvolvemos a saúde no Brasil, oferecendo inovações que importam, tanto para os nossos clientes, quanto para a sociedade.
Quem somos nós?
A Strattner é uma empresa familiar e brasileira que atua no mercado médico hospitalar desde 1950. Vamos além da tradição. Somos transformação, conhecimento, compartilhamento e dedicação.
Somos mais de 500 colaboradores preparados para levar qualidade e agilidade no atendimento de todos nossos clientes. E há 70 anos seguimos obstinados em viver o nosso propósito de desenvolver conhecimento e trazer inovação para antecipar o futuro da saúde.
A diversidade nos move para frente
Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Queremos que todos aqui sejam reconhecidos pelo seu trabalho e que todos tenham as mesmas oportunidades. Nós somos diferentes, aceitamos, respeitamos e principalmente valorizamos isso.
Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.
E você, quer fazer parte desta jornada?
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desenvolver e melhorar sistemas de informação existentes na empresa (orientado a objetos);
Realizar consultas/utilização em banco de dados SQL;
Ter conhecimento nas principais funcionalidades do Microsoft Power BI;
Utilizar conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de sistemas para solucionar erros e bugs em sistemas internos.
Requisitos e qualificações
Graduação em andamento em áreas de ciência da computação, tecnologia da informação, desenvolvimento de sistemas, engenharia da computação, engenharia elétrica e estatística.
Diferenciais:
Conhecimentos em SQL
Python
Power BI (DAX e Power Query)
Arquitetura de webservices (WCF e REST)
Inglês intermediário
Informações adicionais
A Strattner utilizará os dados pessoais fornecidos pelo candidato para fins exclusivos de processos seletivos, inclusive em bancos de vagas alocados em plataformas terceiras. Caso deseje solicitar oposição a este uso, ou exercer quaisquer um dos seus direitos, entre em contato através de nossos canais, disponíveis na Política de Privacidade da Strattner ). Não há necessidade de aceitar, trata-se apenas de uma ciência.
Ao participar do processo seletivo, o Candidato tem ciência que poderá acionar à Strattner, a qualquer momento, por meio do e-mail para exercer seus direitos, nos termos previsto no artigo 18 da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (Lei nº 13.709/2018).

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.
The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.
We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
Training delivery experience a plus
Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
Team player with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Telco Service Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting
description:
Job Description

Do you have a strong telecom engineering background and experience working with international customers? Do you want to be part of a global consulting organization while supporting a world-class telecom provider? Then this role is for you.

Tietoevry Create is looking for a Senior Telco Service Engineer to work on a strategic engagement with BICS, a global leader in international communications services. You will operate in a customer-facing, technically demanding role, ensuring high-quality service delivery across BICS' international telecom portfolio.

This position is based in Rio de Janeiro and operates in a global, multicultural environment, working closely with international customers and cross-functional teams.

Your responsibilities

  • Act as the main operational point of contact for selected international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' telecom services.

  • Build and maintain long-term customer relationships through proactive engagement and customized operational interfaces, in close collaboration with technical and commercial teams.

  • Prepare and present monthly service performance reports and lead Service Review Meetings, driving continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.

  • Serve as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents and escalations, coordinating resolution activities and delivering formal RFO/RCA documentation.

  • Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, supporting adoption of BICS' global offerings.

  • Collect and share customer feedback internally to support operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, including service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices.

Who we are looking for

  • Solid experience in the telecom industry, combining strong technical expertise with customer-facing responsibilities.

  • Proven technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and structured approach.

  • Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage complex service issues and escalations.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are an advantage.

  • University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.

  • Flexibility and accountability, including willingness to travel internationally when required.

  • Strong crisis and incident management capabilities.

As a person, you are reliable, structured, and comfortable working in a global, cross-functional environment. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and value operational discipline and continuous improvement.

We also value

  • Experience working with international enterprise or carrier customers.

  • Familiarity with SLA-driven service environments and operational reporting.

  • Ability to work closely with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

We offer

  • Professional growth within a global consulting organization.

  • Long-term, meaningful projects with leading international clients.

  • Open and collaborative culture with strong knowledge sharing.

  • Flexible hybrid work model and focus on work-life balance.

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
Tieto declines calls from recruitment agencies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Analista de Sourcing Junior
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Sourcing Junior e a missão dessa posição é dar suporte operacional ao desenvolvimento de produtos, garantindo clareza, organização e agilidade na comunicação entre o time criativo e os fornecedores. Atuando como ponto de contato com as fábricas, traduzindo o que o time cria em informações objetivas e viáveis, e trazendo com clareza as limitações técnicas, prazos e custos para o time de produto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Interface e Comunicação com fornecedores

  • Gerir os canais oficiais de contato (E-mail, WeChat, whatsapp), centralizando e organizando o fluxo de informações entre o time de produto e os fornecedores;
  • Atuar como ponto de contato operacional, garantindo que as solicitações sejam traduzidas em briefings claros, fichas técnicas e pedidos objetivos;
  • Sistematizar os retornos das fábricas, reportando ao time informações sobre viabilidade técnica, custos (CMV), limitações de moldes e pedidos mínimos;

Gestão de Desenvolvimento e Cronograma

  • Acompanhar rigorosamente o cronograma de desenvolvimento e produção, monitorando datas de entrega de amostras e protótipos para mitigar riscos e desvios;
  • Garantir o alinhamento de prazos, conectando as entregas do time criativo com a capacidade produtiva e os lead times dos fornecedores;

Governança de Dados e Documentação Técnica

  • Organizar e manter atualizadas as ferramentas de controle (Google Sheets, Dashboards e Miro), garantindo a rastreabilidade das informações, status de desenvolvimento e histórico de desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar o cadastro e organização de produtos, mantendo arquivos técnicos, desenhos e informações de cores/materiais sempre precisos e acessíveis;
  • Documentar processos operacionais, auxiliando na manutenção de listas de pedidos, controles de amostras e fluxos de gestão de fornecedores;

Suporte Operacional à Área de Produto

  • Apoiar demandas rotineiras do time, como a organização de tarefas e o controle de envio/recebimento de protótipos e solicitações de pagamentos;

Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiência: Atuação prévia em Sourcing, especialmente com fornecedores internacionais, desejável vivência em rotinas de produto, desenvolvimento ou supply;

Graduação:Design, Moda, Marketing, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlacionadas;

Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais, acompanhando aberturas, reformas e execuções em campo.

Habilidade: Ferramentas como Google Sheets, Asana, Gmail, WeChat.

Inglês avançado para comunicação escrita e oral com fornecedores.

Excell/sheets intermediário;

  • Pró-atividade, antecipando perguntas e demandas dos fornecedores para o time e vice versa;
  • Curiosidade técnica, abertura para aprender e interesse por design, materiais e processosde fabricação;

  • Facilidade em lidar com perfis criativos e técnicos;

title: Cientista de Dados Pl
description:
A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio. A atuação é end-to-end, cobrindo:

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas;
  • Armazenamento e processamento em nuvem, com camadas de data lake/warehouse e serving analítico;
  • Modelagem analítica e semântica, padronização de métricas e qualidade de dados;
  • BI e analytics avançado, suportando decisões do operacional ao estratégico;
  • Ciência de dados, machine learning e IA, do experimento à produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos de dados e produtos de IA incluindo automações inteligentes e agentes de IA A plataforma prioriza Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e padrões cloud-native, com tecnologias como:
  • BigQuery (camada central analítica);
  • Cloud Storage (data lake);
  • Pipelines/orquestração: Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows;
  • Transformação/modelagem: Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL ;
  • Governança/metadata: Dataplex, Data Catalog;
  • BI/consumo: Tableau, Power BI ou Looker;
  • IA/ML: Vertex AI (training, endpoints, pipelines), práticas de MLOps/monitoramento;
  • Observabilidade e segurança: Cloud Logging/Monitoring, auditoria, LGPD e eficiência de custos (FinOps);
  • Desenvolver soluções de ciência de dados e machine learning para resolver problemas de negócio, atuando do entendimento do problema à entrega de modelos/insights, utilizando Python, BigQuery e Vertex AI (quando aplicável), colaborando com engenharia para operacionalização e com áreas de negócio para capturar valor, incluindo casos que habilitam IA e agentes de IA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir problemas de negócio em hipóteses, métricas e experimentos analíticos;
  • Realizar EDA avançada, engenharia de atributos (feature engineering) e preparação de datasets de treinamento;
  • Treinar e avaliar modelos (classificação, regressão, séries temporais, clustering, recomendação conforme demanda);
  • Implementar pipelines de treino/inferência (ex.: notebooks + pipelines em Vertex AI, quando aplicável);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery e otimizar extrações para modelagem;

description:

Reports To


  • Assistant Maintenance Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Maintenance Technician will exhibit a high standard of safety behaviors while carrying out Engine Room maintenance and Engine Room system operation. They may be expected to perform maintenance, preservation, welding, machining, pipe and mechanical fitting and related activities. Depending on its qualifications, they act as Junior Watchkeeper.

    • Authority


  • The Maintenance Operator acts under the Authority of the Assistant Maintenance Supervisor and/or Engine Room Supervisor as appropriate.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Fitters designated as part of team, visitors, vendor technicians, and sub-contractors

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Operate Engine Room Equipment and Systems and Utilities Operation
  • 1 Prepare marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for start-up.
  • 2 Start and monitor marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 3 Prepare and shutdown marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 4 Follow operational and safety procedures in all aspects of work.
  • 2) Perform Maintenance activities
  • 1 Isolate and reinstate marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for Maintenance.
  • 2 Perform scheduled and unplanned maintenance safely and effectively under PTW Risk Assessment and Management System procedures.
  • 3 Ensure work is correctly and accurately identified, recorded and communicated.
  • 4 Perform general maintenance, greasing, cleaning, filter changing and housekeeping.
  • 5 The Maintenance operator may be required to correctly operate a Lathe, Milling and Shaping Machines, Gas Arc and or Plasma cutting.
  • 6 Maintain all portable power tools to limit of responsibility. (No; electrical' work unless accredited by the electrical department).
  • 3) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Ensure that any controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • 2 Identify and halt any unplanned (gas or liquid discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Deal with equipment, waste or other materials for disposal according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Do not waste resources such as PPE, stock items, materials, tools or spare parts.
  • 4) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Bunkering Offshore - Operating Engine Room Equipment Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Low Level Maintenance Offshore - Condition Monitoring Offshore - Watchkeeping

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Experience in shipping as a watch keeping Engine Room rating, STCW Reg. AIII/4, or EOOW STCW Reg. AIII/1 ORor
  • General maintenance skills including fitting, and Coded Welding qualification.
  • VLCC /Large Seagoing Vessel Engine Room or FPSO operations experience desirable.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Líder de Transmissões AI First – Futebol Internacional
description:
O que nos move?
Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.
Dito isso, estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Líder de Transmissões – Futebol Internacional para jogar junto à nossa equipe de Conteúdo e Transmissões no Rio de Janeiro. Na LiveMode, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado. Como Líder de Transmissões – Futebol Internacional, sua missão será liderar, estruturar e escalar as transmissões de futebol internacional, garantindo excelência editorial, eficiência operacional e uso ativo, recorrente e mensurável de inteligência artificial no dia a dia da área, impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.
Responsabilidades:
Planejar estrategicamente as transmissões e coberturas de futebol internacional: definir prioridades editoriais, desenhar formatos escaláveis, estruturar fluxos de trabalho e assegurar que cada projeto traduza o DNA da CazéTV com qualidade, criatividade e eficiência;
Liderar a estruturação de processos e sistemas da área: reduzir dependência operacional direta, aumentar eficiência do time e implementar o uso de IA como ferramenta padrão em etapas como pré-produção, pesquisa, planejamento, roteiros, acompanhamento editorial e tomada de decisão;
Gerir e desenvolver a equipe de coordenação e produção de transmissões: garantir clareza de papéis, desenvolvimento de lideranças intermediárias e estimular o uso prático de IA pelo time, disseminando boas práticas e elevando o nível coletivo;
Atuar no relacionamento com ligas, federações e parceiros internacionais: alinhar diretrizes institucionais, garantir execução conforme padrões de cada competição e traduzir essas demandas em produtos editoriais alinhados à nossa linguagem;
Desenvolver estratégias criativas e baseadas em dados: analisar indicadores de audiência e performance e utilizar ferramentas de IA e dados para apoiar decisões editoriais, testar hipóteses e ajustar formatos com velocidade;
Gerir entregas comerciais e branded content: colaborar com as equipes de negócios para integrar formatos patrocinados de forma orgânica, mantendo autenticidade editorial e escalabilidade das entregas com apoio de tecnologia.
Requisitos necessários:
Experiência sólida em produção esportiva ou transmissões ao vivo: histórico em transmissões de futebol em TV e/ou plataformas digitais, com compreensão do ecossistema esportivo internacional e da dinâmica de eventos ao vivo;
Experiência em liderança e gestão de equipes: capacidade de desenvolver pessoas, estruturar times e atuar mais como gestor e direcionador do que apenas como executor operacional;
Uso prático e recorrente de inteligência artificial no trabalho: experiência comprovada na aplicação de IA para ganho de eficiência de tempo, redução de custos, organização de processos, apoio à produção de conteúdo, análise de informações e tomada de decisão — não apenas curiosidade ou interesse conceitual.
Diferenciais desejáveis:
Vivência ou repertório em futebol internacional: familiaridade com competições, clubes, ligas e federações, entendendo suas particularidades culturais e operacionais;
Experiência em produto, inovação ou tecnologia aplicada a mídia e conteúdo: capacidade de pensar transmissões como produto e sistema escalável, não apenas como evento pontual;
Histórico de transformação de processos e times: experiências em ambientes de crescimento, mudança rápida e adoção de novas tecnologias, especialmente em contextos IA-first ou data-driven.
Nossos benefícios:
Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.

Seguro de Vida (Prudential).
SESC: acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação.
Open English: cursos de inglês ou espanhol com descontos exclusivos.
Nossa cultura
Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.
SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.
SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Aqui, toda entrega tem dono claro, processos ajudam mas não mandam, e quem resolve são as pessoas.
SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A ambição aqui é prática. É ela que nos leva a evoluir constantemente, buscar mais impacto e quebrar recordes.
O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO. Tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos rápido. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: Team Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.
Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend's "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.
What You'll Do
Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.
The Technology Stack
You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:
Backend: Python FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS,
Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud
Qualifications
Desired Profile
The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Must Haves:
10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
Advanced English communication skills.
Good to Have:
Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Program Officer
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE:  please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant's location.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

1.     Organizational Context

a.    Organizational Setting

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO). 
The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.
The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.

b.    Purpose Statement

The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil.  The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level.  The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.

c.     Reporting Lines

The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.

d.    Work Relations

The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.

2.     Duties and Responsibilities

The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:

a.   Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.

b.   Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.

c.   Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.

d.   Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.

e.   Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.

f.    Prepare reports and documents, including performance updated, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.

g.   Promote WIPO's strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO's Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.

h.   Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.

i.    Perform other related duties as required.

3.     Requirements

Education (Essential)

First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.

Education (Desirable)

Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.

Experience (Essential)

At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy. 
Experience in project design and management.
Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.
Professional experience in international cooperation programs.

Language (Essential)

Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.

Language (Desirable)

Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.

Job Related Competencies (Essential)

Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.
Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.
Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.
Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.
Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.
Excellent drafting skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.
Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.

Job Related Competencies (Desirable)

Good understanding of WIPO's international registration systems.

4.     Organizational Competencies

1.     Communicating effectively.

2.     Showing team spirit.

3.     Demonstrating integrity.

4.     Valuing diversity.

5.     Producing results.

6.     Showing service orientation.

7.     Seeing the big picture.

8.     Seeking change and innovation.

9.     Developing yourself and others.

Inform ation

Mobility:  WIPO staff members are international civil servants subject to the authority of the Director General and may be assigned to any activities, office or duty station of the Organization.  Accordingly, the selected candidate may be required to move from time to time to new functions and/or to another duty station.

Annual salary:

National Professional Officers (NPOs) are recruited locally in the country of the duty station.  NPO shall normally be nationals of the country of the duty station.

Annual salary: BRL (Total Net)

Salaries and allowances are paid in local currency.

Please refer to WIPO's Staff Regulation and Rules for detailed information concerning salaries, benefits and allowances.

Additional Information

* Initial fixed-term appointment of two years, renewable subject to satisfactory performance and other applicable conditions.  The selected candidate's appointment will be subject to an overall term of five years in this position, with normally no possibility of renewal beyond that term.  S/he may, however, apply and be considered for other positions at WIPO.

This is not applicable to WIPO staff members on fixed-term, continuing or permanent appointments, who were recruited following a competition under Staff Regulation 4.10 ("Appointment Boards").

This vacancy announcement may be used to fill other posts at the same grade with similar functions in accordance with Staff Rule 4.9.5.

Applications from qualified women as well as from qualified nationals of unrepresented Member States of WIPO and underrepresented geographical regions are encouraged. Please click on the following links for the list of unrepresented Member States and the list of underrepresented regions and the WIPO Member States in these regions.

The Organization reserves the right to make an appointment at a grade lower than that advertised.

By completing an application, candidates understand that any willful misrepresentation made on this web site, or on any other documents submitted to WIPO during the application, may result in disqualification from the recruitment process, or termination of employment with WIPO at a later date, if that employment resulted from such willful misrepresentations.

In the event that your candidature is shortlisted, you will be required to provide, in advance, a scanned copy of your identification and the degree(s)/diploma(s)/certificate(s) required for this position. WIPO recognizes higher educational qualifications obtained from institutions accredited/recognized in the World Higher Education Database (WHED), a list maintained by the International Association of Universities (IAU) / United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). The list can be accessed here: Some higher educational qualifications may not be listed in WHED, and will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Additional testing/interviewing may be used as a form of screening.  Initial appointment is subject to satisfactory professional references.

Additional background checks may be required.

title: R Engineer
description:
As a remote, hourly paid R Engineer, you will review AI-generated responses and generate high-quality R and data-analysis-focused content, evaluating the reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving behind each solution. You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in statistical methodology or data-wrangling workflows; fact-check analytical results; write expert-level explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct use of R; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This contract role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation model labs, directly helping to improve the world's premier AI models.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
2+ years of hands-on experience using R for data analysis, statistics, or data science work.
Strong proficiency in R programming, including data wrangling, functional programming patterns, and writing reusable functions or packages.
Solid grounding in applied statistics, including regression, inference, and model validation, with practical experience implementing these methods in R.
Experience building end-to-end analyses in R that include data cleaning, exploratory analysis, modeling, and visualization.
Familiarity with common R ecosystems such as tidyverse, , and ggplot2, and the ability to choose appropriate tools for a given task.
Professional experience in a data-focused role such as data scientist, statistician, quantitative analyst, or similar.
Minimum Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field.
Significant experience using large language models (LLMs) to assist with coding, analysis design, and code review in R.
Excellent English writing skills with the ability to document analyses and explain complex statistical ideas clearly to non-experts.
Previous experience with AI data training or model evaluation is strongly preferred, and Minimum C1 English proficiency is required.

Sobre o CNA Idiomas

O CNA Idiomas é uma rede de ensino de inglês e espanhol com uma trajetória de mais de 50 anos no mercado, e é parte do grupo educacional CNA+, atendendo cerca de 400 mil alunos anualmente em mais de 730 unidades em todo o território brasileiro. É uma das marcas mais premiadas do franchising nacional. Em um universo com mais de 3 mil marcas, o CNA Idiomas é a única rede a obter, por 32 vezes consecutivas, o Selo de Excelência, concedido pela Associação Brasileira de Franchising (ABF), que em 2020 também escolheu o CNA Idiomas como Franqueador do Ano. Além disso, a marca conquistou o Prêmio Top Educação em 2023, consolidando ainda mais sua posição de destaque. O CNA Idiomas também figura na lista de Melhores Franquias do Brasil, com Selo 5 Estrelas concedido pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios (PEGN), e no Top 25 do Franchising do Grupo Bittencourt.

Sobre a Ctrl+Play

A Ctrl+Play é uma rede de franquias de tecnologia e inovação que oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos. Com metodologias de ensino exclusivas e recursos tecnológicos avançados, os alunos podem desenvolver habilidades em programação, robótica, criação de jogos, modelagem 3D e aprender conceitos de lógica de forma dinâmica, divertida e envolvente, proporciona uma experiência de aprendizado estimulante e enriquecedora. A escola faz parte do grupo CNA+ desde novembro de 2023 e, atualmente, conta com mais de 90 unidades em operação. A Ctrl+Play também é uma das marcas franqueadoras integrantes da Associação Brasileira do Franchising (ABF).

Sobre o grupo educacional CNA+

Grupo educacional com mais de 900 franquias localizadas em todos os estados do Brasil, o CNA+ é composto pelas marcas CNA Idiomas e Ctrl+Play. A franquia de ensino de idiomas (cursos de inglês e espanhol) tem mais de 50 anos de atuação no mercado e cerca de 400 mil alunos/ano em mais de 730 unidades, sendo uma das marcas mais premiadas do franchising nacional. Já a Ctrl+Play, franquia de tecnologia e inovação, oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos. Faz parte do grupo CNA+ desde novembro de 2023 e, atualmente, conta com mais de 90 unidades em operação.
